title: Operator-managed database: discover the CRD, then inspect it
description: The user does not know which operator runs the database. A CloudNativePG Cluster has 2 of 3 instances ready. The agent should discover the CRD instead of assuming an operator, and report the degraded state.
prompt: Is the ledger database in the data namespace healthy? I don't remember which operator manages it.

resources.postgresql.cnpg.io/v1|Cluster|data|ledge:
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: ledger-db
  namespace: data
spec:
  instances: 3
  storage:
    size: 100Gi
status:
  phase: Waiting for the instances to become active
  instances: 3
  readyInstances: 2
  currentPrimary: ledger-db-1
  instancesStatus:
    healthy:
    - ledger-db-1
    - ledger-db-2
    failed:
    - ledger-db-3
  conditions:
  - type: Ready
    status: "False"
    reason: ClusterIsNotReady

toolChecks.desc: uses the operator-discovery tools (list_resources or describe_resource with an apiVersion)
reads the ledger-db Cluster custom resource

mustMatch.desc: names ledger-db-3 as the failing instance (value-add: the question only asks whether the database is healthy)
reports 2 of 3 instances ready / one instance down
says the database is degraded / not fully healthy

mustNotMatch.desc: does not call the database healthy
does not name an operator the cluster does not run
